verdicts.reason: A cuts the hero photo down to a tiny sliver where the eyes are barely visible, so the design loses its key imagery. Its vertical gold rule runs through the right edge of the headline, the gold bars are scattered at random across the empty lower half, and the dots are tiny. B keeps a readable photo band with the eyes visible and puts the headline in a clear block below it, with the gold bar under FUTURE as in the original. Its flaws are a stray white bar on the photo, dots crowding the photo's right edge, and a vertical rule pressed tight against the text.
